expected_issues.title: Descriptors removed from parents while engines iterate their children
expected_issues.description:
The cleanup listener removes each finished descriptor from its parent while engines are still iterating the parent's getChildren(), which is only an unmodifiable view over the live set, causing ConcurrentModificationException in engines such as the Suite and Vintage engines.

AbstractTestDescriptor.getChildren() returns Collections.unmodifiableSet(children): it cannot be modified through the view but reflects concurrent changes. Engines typically do `for (child : descriptor.getChildren()) execute(child)`; with the new option enabled, executionFinished(child) calls child.removeFromHierarchy(), mutating the set being iterated. Either getChildren() must return a copy or removal must be deferred until the parent finishes.
